properties.title: NRC Report: Processed Water near Edmundston, CN
properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 1295427 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: TWIN RIVERS PAPER
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1295427
Incident Time: 2021-01-03 18:18:00
Nearest City: Edmundston, CN
Location: 27 RUE RICE
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: PROCESSED WATER
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: TWIN RIVERS PAPER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 47.3675, -68.328611 (Explicit)
Report DescriptionFROM ENVIRONMENTAL AND CLIMATE CHANGE CANADA... CALLER REPORTS A RUPTURE OF A WHITE WATER LINE ON AN UNDERGROUND PIPELINE BETWEEN THEIR PLANT AND THE ONE IN THE UNITED STATES. THE PLANT WAS NOT IN OPERATION, THEY WERE CIRCULATING THE WATER BETWEEN THE TWO FACTORIES. A CITIZEN SAW WATER COMING OUT OF THE ASPHALT (AT FERRY STREET AND BOUCHER BRIDGE, NEAR THE FLEA MARKET) AND CONTACTED THE PLANT AT 18H18. A SUPERVISOR WENT ON SITE TO CHECK WHAT IT WAS AND AT 18H31 HE CONFIRMED IT WAS RECIRCULATING WATER. THE PUMPS WERE STOPPED. IT IS UNCERTAIN WHEN THE INCIDENT STARTED. THE FLOW RATE IS ESTIMATED AT 25 GALLONS / MINUTE. CALLER WAS CONTACTED AT AROUND 19H00 AND TOOK SAMPLES. THE WATER GOT ON THE ASPHALT AND SNOW; SOME WENT TO THE MOUTH OF THE MAWASKA AND SAINT JOHN RIVER. THEY WILL EXCAVATE THE GROUND UP TO THE PIPE AND VACUUM THE PRODUCT WITH A VACUUM TRUCK TO BRING IT BACK TO THE PLANT WHERE IT WILL BE REDIRECTED TO THE SEWAGE SYSTEM. THE FINAL REPORT WILL BE SENT TOMORROW. EED-ACT 2021/01/03 AT 21H06. MM
